name: io.github.davincc77/mechacut
title: mechacut
description: Deterministic compute bench for AI agents: exact money, dates, units, hashes, text, CSV and diff transforms over one MCP surface. Every response carries its own sha256; every 400 names the field and the expected shape; ambiguous inputs are refused with both readings, never guessed. Keyless free tier; paid routes settle x402 USDC on Base. Live catalog and counts: mechacut.studio/agent/manifest
